question: Can Jātavedas be invoked to bring golden Lakṣmī to the supplicant?
premises: Jātavedas is addressed as the agent capable of bringing.
Golden Lakṣmī is the desired object to be brought.
The supplicant requests this bringing for himself.
inference: Therefore the supplicant invokes Jātavedas to bring golden Lakṣmī to him.
uncertainties: The form ma is taken as the enclitic first-person pronoun in sandhi context.
plain_english: O Jātavedas, bring golden Lakṣmī to me.
